does this mean that colgate and the other brand of dish soap with palm all over whatever bought tom's of main out

yes, colgate-palmolive (makers of colgate toothpaste and palmolive dish soap) bought a controlling 84% stake in tom's of maine in 2006 for $100 million; founders retained 16%. [1][2] this predates lead reports by nearly 20 years, with no direct link established between ownership and contamination. [1]

## ownership details
colgate-palmolive acquired tom's to tap the growing natural products market, keeping its kennebunk, maine base and leadership intact. [1][3] palmolive dish soap is a core colgate-palmolive brand (from coconut/palm/olive oils since 1898), confirming the connection. [4][5]

## lead context
contamination issues surfaced recently (2024-2025 tests/lawsuits), handled under colgate's oversight but tied to tom's manufacturing/fda issues like bacteria, not acquisition. [6][1]
